alate: Outline of the head nearly circular, ocelli and compound eyes both small; postclypeus distinctly raised, its length equal to or less than half its width, the posterior margin arched; fontanelle distinct, situated rather far back; antennae 15 segments. Middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave; the posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum each with a narrow pointed triangular incision. Wing surface brown; the media of the forewing arising from the radial sector and running close to the cubitus. Tibial spurs 3:2:2, tarsi 3-segmented.
soldier: Body colour mainly yellowish brown: head yellowish brown, mandibles deep blackish brown, postmentum yellowish brown with darker margins, postclypeus, labrum and antennae pale yellow, pronotum dull yellow, the tergites and sternites of the mesothorax and metathorax and the legs still paler. The fine hairs of the anterior part of the head are dense, becoming sparser posteriorly, the posterior end nearly bare; the base of the mandibles bears short hairs; the thorax and abdomen bear long and short hairs intermixed; the pronotum is sparsely hairy, with long hairs only along the anterior margin, the long hairs of the abdominal tergites rather dense, and the tibiae also bear long hairs. Head broadly cylindrical and very stout, the sides almost parallel, the posterior lateral parts broadly rounded; mandibles stout, each with one marginal tooth.
